changelog: Fixes the series toggle flickering, swapping back and forth with the Spoiler Guard button from Jellyfin Enhanced. Both buttons insisted on sitting immediately before the ... button and shoved each other aside on their own timers; the toggle now takes its place once and only moves again if it leaves the container. Also keys a row's exclusions to the user the row was built for rather than the caller, so an administrator or an API key asking for somebody else's row gets that person's switched-off series applied to it.
description: Clears the first episodes of never-started series out of Next Up and collapses duplicate episodes of one series in Continue Watching, so both rows only hold shows you are actually watching. Filtering changes no watch data; an opt-in scheduled task can also clear the play state of barely-started episodes.
name: Next Up Cleanup
overview: Next Up without the first episode of every show you never started, and Continue Watching without the same show four times.
